title: Parallel Tasks

body.text: — each task has its own environment. Kick off 3–4 tasks in the morning, then come back to review the results in the afternoon.

example: "Morning: assign 'fix the login bug' + 'add checkout tests' + 'update README' → Afternoon: review 3 PRs"

title: Split work for good parallelism

body.text: — if two tasks edit the same file, you get a merge conflict. Group work by zones of the code instead.

example: "Parallelizable: fix the login page + write API tests + update docs / Bad: two tasks both editing utils.ts"
